title: Shinobazu Pond
series: Famous Places in the Eastern Capital (Tōto meisho 東都名所)

tags.evidence: Warm peach glow filling the lower sky under a dark top band, red lanterns hung along the pond-side teahouse -> leaning dusk. Lotus leaves and blossoms on the pond -> summer.

title: No. 05, Ōmiya Station: Distant View of Mount Fuji
artist: Eisen 英泉; Publisher: Takenouchi Magohachi
series: The Sixty-nine Stations of the Kisokaidō, here called Kisokaidō 木曾街道

tags.evidence: Cherry trees in bloom along the road and fields; pale sky under a blue band, bright light: clear spring day. Snow-capped Fuji in the distance is not snow on the ground.
